issue.title: [Bug][snappi] - Queue stats counter will report incorrect value for certain ingress-egress port combinations

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Function run_traffic_and_collect_stats runs the tests and then looks for packets per priority from output of 'show queue counter'.

The key used here is dutname + port to go through the stats captured and then prints it out in the text file. However, the key can be issue if the ingress and egress ports are very similar. Example - this will be an issue for ingress port as Ethernet16 and egress port as Ethernet160. The counters should be checked for dut-name+Ethernet160, but however, the if condition will be true for dut-name+Ethernet16, as well. Same applies for ingress port of Ethernet24 and egress of Ethernet240. For these 2 port combinations, queue counters will be reported for ingress port instead of egress port.

Following code:
```
        prio_key = ['_prio_']
        for dut, port in dutport_list:
            new_key = (dut.hostname + '_' + port).lower()
            prio_dict = {}
            for item in results:
                for key in prio_key:
                    if (new_key in item and key in item.split(new_key)[1]):
                        prio_dict[item.split(new_key)[1]] = df_t[item].max()
```

Impacted testcases:
- snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_mixed_speed.py
- snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_no_congestion_throughput.py
- snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_port_congestion.py
- snappi_tests/pfcwd/test_pfcwd_mixed_speed.py
- snappi_tests/pfcwd/test_pfcwd_actions.py

### Steps to Reproduce

Run one of the above testcases with ingress port as Ethernet16 and egress as Ethernet60.  Other combination could be Ethernet24 and Ethernet240. Once test finishes, check the text file to check for the packets received for the egress ports.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The packets per priority might not be correct for certain port combinations.

Actual behavior:

resolution.title: [Snappi]: Fixed the Queue counter stats key issue for certain ingress-egress port combination.
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #20897

### Type of change

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Certain port combinations, for example - Ethernet16 as ingress port and Ethernet160 as egress port on the same DUT will cause the queue stats counters to be incorrectly reported in the generated summary file.
This will also be true if the ingress port is Ethernet24 and egress is Ethernet240 on the same DUT. The queue counter stats use 'dut-name+port counter' as key combination, and hence dut-name + Ethernet16 would also pass as key-name for dut-name + Ethernet160.

#### How did you do it?
Added a small key factor - dut-name + port + '_prio_' as the key, and hence checks for the exact keyword instead of dut-name + port.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Captured the output of the file with and without the fix.
